identity.resource_limits: Logical allocated resources; excludes browser/driver/process/canvas swapchain and upload implementation overhead

source_policy: Fresh complete graph at 40+(index*1.1)%180 source seconds; no histories/reuse; phase sweep independent of display speed.
render_timestamp_warning: Render beginning timestamps precede producer passes on this adapter; individual render pass durations are invalid, retained only for diagnosis. Whole graph uses compute-to-compute sentinels.
scope: assembled1280x720 prototype; no capture during timing; GPU per-pass timings exclude copies/interpass overhead; queue completion includes driver/observer, not GPU execution; M3 local not M2/full Thrum certification
